exposure: Laparoscopic uterine artery pre-ligation (LUAP) combined with hysteroscopic curettage
Uterine artery embolization (UAE) combined with hysteroscopic curettage
outcome: Incidence of short-term postoperative complications (fever, pelvic pain)
Incidence and severity of intrauterine adhesions
cohort: Patients with type II cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) treated at the Maternal and Child Health Hospital of Hubei Province between 2018 and 2022.
finding: Laparoscopic uterine artery pre-ligation (LUAP) combined with hysteroscopic curettage is a safe and effective surgical scheme for treating type II Cesarean scar pregnancies, demonstrating lower costs, fewer short and long-term complications, and better postoperative pregnancy outcomes compared to uterine artery embolization (UAE).
